No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. Selected multipolar neuron keeps one soma with one nucleus, five illustrative bifurcating dendrite roots, one continuous rightward axon, five separate myelin segments with four exposed intersegment nodes, and three terminal branches. The axon is strongly shortened, myelin sheaths independently thickened, and the soma/nucleus enlarged to preserve physical gaps and cell interiors. Sheaths represent supporting glia rather than five neuronal axons. Initial and terminal bare spans are not additional counted nodes. Original 2.4 mm neurite and 1.4 mm outline roles remain; this is not a signal-direction, universal dendrite-count or calibrated anatomical model.", "canvas_mm": [170, 125]}, "teaching": "Selected multipolar neuron keeps one soma with one nucleus, five illustrative bifurcating dendrite roots, one continuous rightward axon, five separate myelin segments with four exposed intersegment nodes, and three terminal branches. The axon is strongly shortened, myelin sheaths independently thickened, and the soma/nucleus enlarged to preserve physical gaps and cell interiors. Sheaths represent supporting glia rather than five neuronal axons. Initial and terminal bare spans are not additional counted nodes. Original 2.4 mm neurite and 1.4 mm outline roles remain; this is not a signal-direction, universal dendrite-count or calibrated anatomical model. External object-name and viewpoint key required; physical tactile and learner evaluation remain pending.
